title: Package, install, desktop shortcut, final captures, handoff and archive
acceptance: the release viewer is installed from the built installer, the desktop shortcut points at the new binary, `cargo xtask verify`, `cargo deny check` and `cargo xtask goal-verify --all` outputs are pasted, final captures exist in all four theme/control combinations, and the handoff and archived plan are in the repo
notes: Release close-out. Build the release viewer, run scripts/package.ps1 -Installer, install it, and confirm the desktop shortcut target is the newly built binary (path and target recorded). Capture the installed build in light and dark, each with native and Windows control styles, with the default Documents\PDFXI library folder. Paste the output of `cargo xtask verify`, `cargo deny check` (currently red on RUSTSEC-2026-0543, see orchestration/blockers/chrono-unmaintained.md) and `cargo xtask goal-verify --all`. Tick every A-/O- row in docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md only after the orchestrator's own installed-build check. Write the handoff under orchestration/handoff/ and archive the plan under the in-repo archive path (docs/plans/archive/**); do not touch ~/.opencode/plan or any global config from this task record.
